props.gloss_en: and eighteen matters they decreed on that day
the stam: the next of the eighteen is the one taught in the mishnah -- all movables bring impurity at the thickness of an ox goad
all movable objects bring impurity at the thickness of an ox goad
R' Tarfon: this halakha is truncated -- the one who heard it heard [a ruling] and erred

R' Tarfon: [the original ruling was that] when a farmer passed with his ox goad on his shoulder and one side of it overshadowed a grave, they declared it impure, because of vessels that overshadow the dead
R' Akiva: I will fix [the rule] so that the words of the Sages endure -- [the goad thickness is the measure for the person carrying]
R' Akiva: all movables bring impurity upon the person who carries them at the thickness of an ox goad
...and upon other people and vessels, at an opening of a handbreadth
R' Yannai: the ox goad they spoke of is one with no handbreadth of thickness but a handbreadth of circumference
R' Yannai: and they decreed on its circumference because of its thickness
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: [the decree that] the daughters of the Kutim are niddot from their cradle was also decreed on that day
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: and in the other [matter] R' Tarfon holds like R' Meir (who reported at 16b.7 that Beit Shammai outnumbered Beit Hillel on the drawn water)

objections.gloss_en: ולרבי טרפון דאמר אקפח את בני שהלכה זו מקופחת -- בצרו להו! -- for R' Tarfon the eighteen fall short

answered_by.gloss_en: אף בנות כותים נדות מעריסתן בו ביום גזרו, ובאידך סבירא ליה כרבי מאיר -- the Kutim decree is one of them, and on drawn water R' Tarfon holds like R' Meir, so the count is complete (= p_kutim_bo_bayom, p_tarfon_kerabbi_meir)
